column2: Cannot get a push certificate on the simulator and reconnects about ten times a second, 55 to 57 percent of all simulator log lines in each light shard (#128). The app uses only local notifications.
Renders widget timelines (#128). The app has no widgets.

Wallet daemon. In run 39558388678 a FrontBoard launch request for passd held dyld's loader lock while paging in from the simulator runtime's disk image, and SpringBoard's main thread waited on that lock through a 30 s screenshot stall (spindump of SpringBoard). The app uses no Wallet passes.
TV provider subscriptions. Logged 370 lines in the 38 s SpringBoard stall of run 39523841066, the most of any system daemon after dasd. The app does not use TV provider sign-in.
Photos library. Ran a 70 s background library migration during run 39523841066 (Finished post migration action: 69.83s). The app does not use Photos.
App Store purchases. Logged 101 lines in the same stall. The app sells nothing.
Downloads and applies experiment configuration on schedule. Logged 50 lines in the same stall. The app runs no experiments.
Watch connectivity. Logged 228 lines in the same stall and retries the disabled apsd every 6.4 s. The app has no watch app.

Siri assistant data, run by the background task scheduler (an XPC activity in its launchd job). The busiest simulator service in the log while Cue's main thread froze for 17.4 s and its JavaScript for 8.3 s in runs 39566312887 and 39568145888 (#143). The app uses no Siri.

Biome event store, run by the background task scheduler (an XPC activity in its launchd job). Among the busiest simulator services in the log during the same Cue freezes (#143). The app donates no activities to Siri or Shortcuts.

Speech recognition and voice trigger, kept alive by launchd while its voice trigger path exists. Among the busiest simulator services in the log during the same Cue freezes (#143). The app takes no speech input.
